label: Blade & Sorcery sandboxes
description: How Blade & Sorcery sandboxes deploy, and how to find the game on this machine. Paths: mo2.

notes: Each mod is a folder in BladeAndSorcery_Data/StreamingAssets/Mods holding a manifest.json; the game reads them at start-up. Delete the mod's folder to remove it.
Saves and settings live in Documents/My Games/BladeAndSorcery, not the install, and are not touched by the sandbox.
Hard links are the default: nothing is copied twice when two sandboxes share a mod, and every file is still a real file to the game.

presets.label: Clean
presets.description: Nothing deployed - the vanilla game, for checking whether a bug is yours.

options.label: Additional launch arguments
options.description: Passed verbatim. One argument per space; nothing here goes through a shell.
